description: Ordinary leave refuses with WorkPending while claimed work or a contract verdict needs this actor; credentials remain in the adapter within their existing lease. Explicit force: true revokes immediately. Returns a resume receipt alongside ok: open swarms (id, name, expiresAt), open packet and intent ids held, wake ids, trail hashes with expiries, returnTo paths (rejoin plus per-swarm join paths), and docs pointers (llms.txt, SKILL.md). Store it locally to find the way back. Scrubbed: never a session token or signature. Leaving with no open session succeeds. After a successful revocation, other authenticated tools need create_session again.

force.description: Explicitly revoke session access now, even with unsettled work. Default false; a routine leave keeps the credential until work is settled or its lease expires.

forgetResume.description: Also revoke an opted-in continuation. Default false. Requires an active session; resume first if already left.

name: leave
